mapper.sql: select session_id, login_name, dept_name, ipaddr, login_location, browser, os, status, start_timestamp, last_access_time, expire_time, session_data from sys_user_online
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_online(session_id, login_name, dept_name, ipaddr, login_location, browser, os, status, start_timestamp, last_access_time, expire_time, session_data) values (#{sessionId}, #{loginName}, #{deptName}, #{ipaddr}, #{loginLocation}, #{browser}, #{os}, #{status}, #{startTimestamp}, #{lastAccessTime}, #{expireTime}, #{sessionData,jdbcType=BLOB,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.BlobTypeHandler}) on conflict (session_id) do update set login_name = excluded.login_name, dept_name = excluded.dept_name, ipaddr = excluded.ipaddr, login_location = excluded.login_location, browser = excluded.browser, os = excluded.os, status = excluded.status, start_timestamp = excluded.start_timestamp, last_access_time = excluded.last_access_time, expire_time = excluded.expire_time, session_data = excluded.session_data
mapper.select: o WHERE o.last_access_time <= #{lastAccessTime} ORDER BY o.last_access_time ASC
